functions.name: is_academy_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_academy_admin(target_academy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.tenant_memberships m
    where m.tenant_id = target_academy_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.status = 'active'
      and m.role in ('owner', 'admin')
  );
$function$

functions.name: is_academy_member
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_academy_member(target_academy_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.tenant_memberships m
    where m.tenant_id = target_academy_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.status = 'active'
  );
$function$
